title: INFRA Act 1 100% (Full Game All Collectibles No Commentary)
confidence_note: principles at game level, not frame-accurate timestamps

observations.observation: Real utility spaces (dams, pump houses, tunnels, substations) read believable because every machine has a function and connects to pipes/cables/signage. Nothing is decorative.
Exploration is the gameplay: walk, inspect, read meters/valves/breakers. No combat needed — the facility itself is the content.
Dread comes from decay, flooding, and failing infrastructure, not monsters. The threat is environmental.
Wayfinding via signage, pools of light, and logical facility layout (follow the pipe = follow the task).
Interactions are environmental state changes (valve, breaker, keypad) that visibly alter the world.
